sentences.text: Petitioner is the sole accused in Crime No.370 of 2022 of Panamaram Police Station, Wayanad District which is now pending as C.P.No.28 of 2023 before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Mananthavady.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Mananthavady
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The petitioner faces allegations of having committed the offences Xxxx vs State Of Kerala on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116769046/
1 punishable under Sections 376, 376 (2)(n) & 450 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. The allegation against the petitioner is that in the month of June 2022, the petitioner had committed rape on the defacto complainant/victim on the false promise of marriage and had thereafter, evaded the defacto complainant/victim.

3. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner and the 2 nd respondent/defacto complainant/victim are now married and they are now living together happily as husband and wife.

It is submitted that in such circumstances, the Crl.M.C. NO.8692 OF 2023 proceedings in Crime No.370 of 2022 of Panamaram Police Station, Wayanad District, which is now pending as C.P.No.28 of 2023 before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Mananthavady may be quashed as against the petitioner.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Mananthavady
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Reference is made in this regard to Annexure A5 marriage certificate issued by the Local Registrar of Marriages, Panamaram Grama Panchayat, Wayanad District.

4. The learned Public Prosecutor and the learned counsel appearing for the 2nd respondent/defacto complainant/victim would confirm that the marriage between the petitioner and the 2nd respondent/defacto complainant/victim was solemnized on 28.08.2023 and that they are now living together as husband and wife.

5. Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, the learned Public Prosecutor and the learned counsel for the 2nd respondent/defacto complainant/victim, I am of the view that the proceedings against the petitioner can be quashed.

The allegation against the petitioner is Crl.M.C.
NO.8692 OF 2023 that on the false promise of marriage he had sexual relationships with the 2nd respondent/defacto complainant/victim and had thereafter started evading her.
It appears that with the passage of time the petitioner has married the 2nd respondent/ defacto complainant/victim.
In such circumstances, it cannot be said that the petitioner has committed the offence as alleged against him.

Accordingly, this Crl.M.C is allowed and all further proceedings against the petitioner in Crime No.370 of 2022 of Panamaram Police Station, Wayanad District which is now pending as C.P.No.28 of 2023 before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Mananthavady will stand quashed as against the petitioner.
Sd/-
